# ARWP Trend Radar

Canonical page: https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/trends/
Machine-readable snapshot: https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/trends/trends.json
Reviewed: 2026-09-06

Purpose:
Track material Search, AI-search, citation and agent-web changes from primary sources and turn confirmed applicable changes into reviewable website actions without claiming that novelty or early adoption guarantees ranking, citation or recommendation outcomes.

Lifecycle:
- WATCH: emerging, experimental or provider-specific; visible but not a default recommendation.
- ADOPT: primary-source-backed and currently actionable for applicable sites.
- MEASURED: ARWP has real longitudinal before/after outcome evidence; correlation is not causation.
- RETIRED: deprecated/historical mechanism kept to prevent stale optimization advice.

Recent ADOPT changes:
- OpenAI publisher/developer guidance: OAI-SearchBot vs GPTBot separation, ChatGPT referral tagging, and WAI-ARIA guidance for ChatGPT Agent in Atlas.
- Google Generative AI Search Console reporting is available to all websites worldwide as of 2026-08-31.
- Google updated site-reputation policy enforcement in the EEA.
- Google Preferred Sources has a custom interactive acquisition button and can surface preferred badges in supported AI Mode / AI Overview experiences.

Recent WATCH changes:
- Cloudflare Browser Run enforces Content Signals `use` semantics for compatible crawl requests.
- WebMCP remains a browser runtime/origin-trial surface; ARWP requires task eval evidence before broad adoption claims.

Run:
node bin/arwp-trends.mjs list --since=30 --exclude-retired
node bin/arwp-trends.mjs list --provider=google --stage=adopt
node bin/arwp-growth.mjs https://example.com --vertical=editorial --json

The Trend Radar has no universal score and does not promise search or AI visibility gains.
